description: This Java class is a Spring configuration component that seeds initial permissions, roles, and an admin user into the database if they do not already exist. It sets up permissions related to user management, projects, tenders, contractors, milestones, payments, and reports, and assigns these permissions to roles such as ADMIN, INSPECTOR, and PROJECT_MANAGER. It then creates an admin user with the ADMIN role if it does not already exist.

classes.name: DataSeeder
classes.description: Spring configuration component that initializes default data in the database during application startup.
